reason: E3 directly supports that lattice distortion in HEAs reduces lattice thermal conductivity through intensified phonon interactions. E4 shows that high configurational entropy via progressive alloying reduces lattice thermal conductivity and enhances ZT in GeTe-based alloys. However, no cited evidence explicitly supports the claimed 400-900 K applicability range, and E1 only defines entropy without linking it to thermal transport.
